passages.geysers: Unlike a simple hot spring that flows continuously, a geyser is defined by its intermittent and forceful eruptions. It requ____ a parti_____ geological config_______: a he__ source, abun____ water, a__ a tig____ constricted under______ plumbing system th__ allows pres____ to build. This setup traps superheated water until it can no longer be contained and bursts forth in a signature column of water and steam that reflects the volatile conditions below the surface. The sheer power released during an eruption makes geysers among Earth’s most dynamic hydrothermal features.

questions.prompt: Question 01: complete requ____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ires → requires。requiresは「必要とする」。Itは間欠泉を受ける単数主語なので三人称単数形です。

questions.prompt: Question 02: complete parti_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：cular → particular。a particular geological configurationは「特定の地質学的配置」。必要な条件を限定します。

questions.prompt: Question 03: complete config_______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：uration → configuration。configurationは「配置・構成」。コロンの後ろで熱源・水・配管系の組み合わせを説明しています。

questions.prompt: Question 04: complete he__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：at → heat。a heat sourceは「熱源」。熱い水を作るための熱を供給します。

questions.prompt: Question 05: complete abun____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：dant → abundant。abundant waterは「豊富な水」。waterを修飾する形容詞です。

questions.prompt: Question 06: complete a__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：nd → and。熱源、水、地下の配管系という列挙の最後を結ぶandです。

questions.prompt: Question 07: complete tig____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：htly → tightly。tightly constrictedは「強く狭められた」。過去分詞constrictedを修飾する副詞です。

questions.prompt: Question 08: complete under______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ground → underground。underground plumbing systemは「地下の配管系」。below the surfaceという後文にも対応します。

questions.prompt: Question 09: complete th__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：at → that。thatはsystemを説明する関係代名詞。圧力が高まることを可能にする仕組みです。

questions.prompt: Question 10: complete pres____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：sure → pressure。allows pressure to buildは「圧力が高まることを可能にする」。噴出前に蓄積するものです。
